card.name: Places right before a P-word starts
card.fires_on: Marks spots where the next piece is likely to begin with p or P, such as pazopanib, phosphodiesterase, PPIs or pantoprazole. It also fires on some digits and dashes in addresses and dates.

modes.label: Before p-drug or enzyme names
modes.description: Fires on the opening or middle piece of a drug or enzyme name just before a p-sound piece.
modes.example: Cilostazol and several of its metabolites are inhibitors of phosph<<odi>>esterase III.

modes.label: Before PPI terms
modes.description: Fires on a linking word or bracket just before PPIs or a p-drug name.
modes.example: Increased INR and prothrombin time in patients receiving PPIs,<< including>> pantoprazole, and warfar

modes.label: Digits and dashes in addresses and dates
modes.description: Fires on a digit in a zip code or a dash between dates.

card.writes: It mostly suppresses tokens starting with p, so it seems to steer the output away from p-initial pieces; the promoted tokens show no clear theme.
card.plain: It fires in drug-label text just ahead of words that start with p, such as pazopanib or phosphodiesterase.
